outcome.technical: Filed under P152.17-6jb (re-add of the cancelled P152.5 and P152.16-6jb, started on a clean tree): scratchpad/p15216.patch applied with `git apply` (exit 0, git diff --stat HEAD: 4 files), then the P152.16 review findings fixed. tests/_harness.py: new section 'a script run in this interpreter' - run_script_in_process(path, args, cwd, stdin=None, env=None, before_main=None) -> (code, stdout bytes, stderr bytes), plus script_parts, child_codec(environ), exit_status, planted_sitecustomize, _is_main_guard, _restore_environ moved from tests/test_drive_phase.py. Semantics are subprocess.run's: env is the WHOLE environment (None inherits), stdin is bytes (str sent as UTF-8, None empty), an escape is a traceback on stderr and status 1, SystemExit None/int/str as the interpreter maps them; argv, cwd, environ, sys.path and the three std streams are restored in a finally. The child codec is read from the env handed in, not this process's. An env whose PYTHONPATH plants a sitecustomize is refused with ValueError before anything is swapped (only a fresh interpreter imports one); test_drive_phase keeps its _needs_process routing (pinned clock, windows stdout, a replaced subprocess) and now asks _harness.planted_sitecustomize for the sitecustomize half. before_main(namespace) replaces the drive-specific run_verb rerouting: test_drive_phase passes _route_verbs. Own cases ip1-ip3 moved byte-identical from the drive suite's ip-block (row and function removed there), new ip4-ip11; ip5/ip6/ip7/ip9 compare against the same script run as a real process. tests/test_drive_phase.py: _run_in_process is now a thin wrapper (env laid over os.environ, as before) around the harness; unused builtins/locale/traceback imports dropped; 759 cases (762 minus the three moved). tests/test_audit_task.py: new _cli_here (in-process _cli, same filtered env, same (exit, stdout) text-mode read) used by every fb call except fb1 (_cli, real process: argv dialect + OS exit status) and fb13's stdin run (_cli_in, real process: '-' off a real pipe); fb14's two stdin runs now _cli_here(stdin=...); lv_call (at4) runs audit-task.py/audit-lock.py in-process with its whole env per call and returns err+out (the 12 sleepers stay real Popen processes); gs_gate (at6) runs run-test-gate.py in-process. sl-block and fp-block still call _cli as processes (not in scope). PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md: one sentence on run_script_in_process in the tests/ _harness.py paragraph. Converted cases still red on the defect: in a HEAD export with these test files, mutating audit-task's JSON refusal wording -> fb5 red (18/19); its 'left in place' wording -> lv7, lv13, lv14 red (79/82); run-test-gate --record inverted -> 17 at6 cases red (53/70); unmutated fb+at4+at6 171/171. cp1252: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py --encoding cp1252 tests/_harness.py tests/test_audit_task.py tests/test_drive_phase.py` exit 0, both halves ran (cp1252 stdio + LANG=C locale), 3/3 files ok, 2067 cases. reach-diff exit 0: base HEAD 7981 lines reached, WORKTREE 7981, lost 0 in 0 functions; processes that started the hook 254 -> 131; same 4-child blind spot in at7-block at both revisions. Dependants sample `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py --quiet tests/test__output_lints.py tests/test__deps.py tests/test_run_test_gate.py tests/test__usage_viz.py tests/test__refs.py tests/test__runner_output.py tests/test_commit_task_work.py tests/test__filed_returns.py` exit 0, 8/8 files ok, 1714 cases.
